# CRAN Readiness & Monorepo Governance Quality Checklist: omopHeor

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, completeness, clarity, and consistency for the omopHeor renaming and CRAN-readiness release suite.
**Created**: 2026-08-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Naming Uniqueness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the global package uniqueness of `omopHeor` verified across both CRAN and Bioconductor? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all files requiring metapackage name replacement explicitly enumerated across `DESCRIPTION`, `tests/testthat.R`, `R/zzz.R`, and documentation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the exact acronyms required for expansion in all `DESCRIPTION` `Description:` fields specified without omission? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the deprecation and migration path from `library(hermes)` to `library(omopHeor)` defined for existing user workflows? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependency & Metadata Compliance

- [ ] CHK005 Are all non-CRAN packages (`Cohort2Trajectory`, `TrajectoryMarkovAnalysis`) and `Remotes:` fields explicitly identified for removal across all 4 `DESCRIPTION` files? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the handling of unused imports (such as `dbplyr` in `CohortCosts`) explicitly defined to prevent `R CMD check` NOTEs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Are canonical HTTPS URL formats without 301 redirects specified for all web links in `DESCRIPTION` and `README.md`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are all cross-package function references (e.g., `CohortCosts::addCosts` in `CohortEconomics` tests) fully qualified in test suites? [Traceability, Spec §FR-007]

## Package Archive Size & Asset Boundaries

- [ ] CHK009 Are the specific files targeted for removal in `packages/CohortCosts/inst/extdata/` explicitly named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the maximum permissible tarball archive size (< 5 MB) clearly bounded as an acceptance criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the distinction between local root data (`data/costs_spain.*`) and distributed package assets explicitly maintained? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Documentation, Examples & CRAN Check Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are execution time budgets (< 5 seconds total runtime) specified for `@examples` using synthetic DuckDB fixtures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Are all primary exported functions across the 3 subpackages and metapackage accounted for in documentation requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the target `R CMD check --no-manual --as-cran` outcome standards (0 Errors, 0 Warnings, <= 1 Note) unambiguously defined? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the multi-wave submission sequence from independent subpackages to metapackage formally documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
